Unguarded setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot; callable by anyone.

Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, balances, allowances and owner.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate is protected solely by the comparison msg.sender == owner.
_mints is gated only by a hardcoded privileged caller address comparison.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
transfer delegates the real work to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating any balances.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall, so owner compromise or misuse drains the contract.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without underflow protection.
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
_mints assigns balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) with an unchecked multiplication.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with an unchecked multiplication.
SafeMath.add performs the raw addition before the overflow require.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw subtraction bounded by a require.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw multiplication checked by division afterwards.
